```{=latex}
\fontsize{7.6}{8.7}\selectfont
\begin{multicols}{2}
\E[0.53]{SOFA, 2 carry it, load on it $\to$ B's force}
  {F_B=\frac{g\,(M\frac{L}{2}+m\,x_m)}{x_B}}
  {$x$ from A's end. $M$ sofa, $L$ length. $m$ load at $x_m$ (far end: $x_m{=}L$). $x_B$ = where B holds (0.4 m from end: $L{-}0.4$). A's force: $(M{+}m)g-F_B$}
\E[0.42]{DIVING BOARD: A at back end, B at $a$}
  {\begin{array}{@{}l@{}}B=\dfrac{L/2}{a}\,Mg\\[6pt] A=B-Mg\end{array}}
  {$L$ length, $M$ board, $a$ = A to B. B pushes up, A pulls down.}
\E[0.40]{SEESAW: where does the adult sit?}
  {x=\frac{L\,m_k}{2\,M_T}}
  {$x$ from CENTER. $m_k$ kid (at end), $M_T$ adult. Seesaw mass: ignore.}
\E[0.57]{WALL BEAM + CABLE: max hang distance}
  {x=\frac{L}{mg}\Big(T\sin\theta-\frac{Mg}{2}\Big)}
  {From wall. $M$ beam, $m$ mass, $T$ cable max, $\theta$ cable--beam.}
\E[0.40]{LADDER, nobody on it: min angle}
  {\theta=\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{2\mu}}
  {$\mu$ floor friction. Wall frictionless.}
\E[0.65]{MAN CLIMBS LADDER: how far up safely?}
  {x=\frac{L}{M}\Big(\mu(M{+}m)\tan\theta-\frac{m}{2}\Big)}
  {$M$ man+load, $m$ ladder, $\theta$ to floor. \textbf{MAX: biggest choice $\le x$}}
\E[0.48]{LADDER: min angle to climb to the TOP}
  {\theta=\tan^{-1}\frac{M+m/2}{(M+m)\,\mu}}
  {$M$ man+load, $m$ ladder. Length doesn't matter.}
\E[0.30]{LIGHT ON 2 CORDS: ceiling cord tension}
  {T=\frac{mg}{\sin\theta}}
  {$m$ light. $\theta$ = cord to CEILING angle.}
\E[0.56]{WIRE stretched by a hanging load}
  {\Delta\ell=\frac{mg\,\ell}{\pi\,(d/2)^{2}\,Y}}
  {$\ell$ wire length. $d$ DIAMETER (halve it). Answer in m.}
\E[0.40]{BLOCK squashed by a mass on top}
  {\Delta h=\frac{mg\,h}{w\,l\,Y}}
  {$w$ width, $l$ length, $h$ height. $\times1000$ = mm.}
\end{multicols}

\newpage

\begin{multicols}{2}
\noindent{\fontsize{5.6}{6.5}\selectfont\textbf{Constants:} $G=6.67{\times}10^{-11}$, $M_E=5.98{\times}10^{24}$, $R_E=6.37{\times}10^{6}$\,m, $M_{sun}=2{\times}10^{30}$, 1\,AU $=1.5{\times}10^{11}$\,m, $c=3{\times}10^{8}$. km\,$\times1000$ = m. 1\,h = 3600\,s, 1\,day = 86{,}400\,s.\par}
\vspace{1.4pt}
\E[0.40]{$g$ at HEIGHT $h$ above Earth}
  {g=\frac{GM_E}{(R_E+h)^{2}}}
  {$h$ in m. Person's mass: ignore.}
\E[0.47]{SATELLITE PERIOD at altitude $h$}
  {T=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{(R_E+h)^{3}}{GM_E}}}
  {Seconds. $\div60$ min, $\div3600$ h, $\div86{,}400$ days.}
\E[0.58]{ALTITUDE for a given PERIOD $T$}
  {h=\Big(\frac{T^{2}GM_E}{4\pi^{2}}\Big)^{1/3}\!-R_E}
  {$T$ in s (h$\times$3600). $\div1000$ = km.}
\E[0.45]{TWO EQUAL STARS orbiting: period}
  {T=4\pi\sqrt{\frac{r^{3}}{GM}}}
  {$r=d/2$ (half the separation). $M$ = ONE star.}
\E[0.74]{ROCKET reaches height $h$: launch speed}
  {v=\sqrt{2GM_E\Big(\frac{1}{R_E}-\frac{1}{R_E+h}\Big)}}
  {m/s. $\div1000$ = km/s.}
\E[0.62]{ROCKET launched at $v$: how high?}
  {h=\frac{2GM_ER_E}{2GM_E-v^{2}R_E}-R_E}
  {Keep all digits. $\div1000$ = km.}
\E[0.40]{ESCAPE SPEED from a planet/moon}
  {v=\sqrt{\frac{2GM}{R}}}
  {That body's $M$, $R$. $\div1000$ = km/s.}
\E[0.40]{EVENT HORIZON (escape speed = $c$)}
  {r=\frac{2GM}{c^{2}}}
  {$M$ black hole. $c=3{\times}10^{8}$.}
\E[0.40]{PLANET'S SPEED around the Sun}
  {v=\sqrt{\frac{GM_{sun}}{r}}}
  {$r$ = AU $\times1.5{\times}10^{11}$ m. $\div1000$ = km/s.}
\E[0.80]{EQUAL PULL: \% of the way from Earth to moon}
  {\%=\frac{100\,k}{1+k}\qquad k=\sqrt{\frac{M_E}{M_{moon}}}}
  {}
\end{multicols}
```
